T1_QUANTILE_OFFSET.name: Quantile Offset Threshold
T1_QUANTILE_OFFSET.note: q frozen at 0.95 (matches the source operating-threshold semantics Q95)

T3_TAIL_EXCEEDANCE.name: Tail Exceedance Correction
T3_TAIL_EXCEEDANCE.rule: alpha_s = P_source-normal(score > tau_source) = 1 - Q95 = 0.05; tau_t = Q_(1-alpha_s)(target-normal) = Q95(target-normal)
T3_TAIL_EXCEEDANCE.note: mathematically identical to T1 given tau_source = Q95(source-normal); registered separately per protocol, evaluated as the same effective rule

T4_ABSTAINING.name: Abstaining Threshold Correction
T4_ABSTAINING.rule: if T3_feature > delta: apply T3 actuator (tau_t = Q95(target-normal)); else NoAdapt (tau_t = tau_source)
T4_ABSTAINING.gate_feature: T3_feature = P_target-normal(score > tau_source) (target exceedance at source threshold)
T4_ABSTAINING.delta_definition: analytically defined as 2x the source-normal nominal exceedance (2 * (1 - Q95) = 2 * 0.05); pre-registered, no test-outcome tuning
T4_ABSTAINING.authorization: B stage proved a stable normal-only scalar (T3_feature) vs correctability relationship (AUC 0.685, PASS-B); low-capacity single-scalar gate

evaluation_contract.coverage: fraction of entities where the actuator applies a non-NoAdapt correction
evaluation_contract.no_parameter_fitting: all candidates are parameter-free pre-registered formulas; T4 delta is a fixed pre-registered constant, so direct evaluation on all 117 entities is a strict OOF evaluation (each entity's target scores are never used for fitting any candidate)

firewall.note: actuator thresholds are computed from DEPLOYABLE inputs only; anomaly scores are used ONLY for the final evaluation metrics
